tasks.short: Read schedules and receive orders to determine pumping amounts

steps.what: Read operating schedules and instructions for the assigned transfer
Receive verbal orders and clarify material, destination and units
Determine amounts to be pumped and resolve conflicting instructions
Record the determined amount against the transfer order

tasks.design: Configure the {OPS_SYSTEM} order view to show the relevant schedule and instructions beside a short amount-entry form. The operator receives verbal changes, resolves conflicts and enters the actual amount and units; no pump command or automatic send is proposed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding the correct instruction and repeatedly entering order identifiers interrupts interpretation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native filtered views and contextual forms may remove navigation and repeated identifiers.
tasks.still_hard: Verbal amendments can conflict with written limits or use ambiguous units.
tasks.human_edge: The operator clarifies intent and notices an amount that does not fit the physical transfer.
tasks.altitude: More time remains for checking ambiguous orders; operating authority does not change.

reach.role: tank car, truck, and ship loader
reach.task: Confirm the receiving vessel and loading quantity
reach.learn: Transfer identifiers, units and receiving constraints

evidence.claim: Contextual order views and prefilled identifiers can reduce navigation and repeated entry; the pumping scenario and savings are unmeasured.

assumptions: Boundary covers receiving instructions, determining an amount and recording it; physical pumping is another task.

The scheduling team produces order id, material, destination, quantity, unit, instruction version and effective time during its existing scheduling work. This design requires no new structured transcription by that team.

The operator captures and checks missing identifiers, verbal changes, amount and unit in s2 through s4; their time remains counted. Missing or contradictory fields lead to manual clarification and ordinary entry, never a guessed amount.
Test native order filters, linked documents and contextual forms before custom code. The same-system save earns no separate saving or self-approval.
Savings in s4 concern repeated identifiers and navigation only. Interpretation, amount entry and unit checking remain human.
unknowns: Whether schedules already have usable order identifiers and linked instructions
How much contextual entry is already configured
research_questions: Does a native order view remove navigation without hiding instruction versions?
How much repeated entry remains after verbal orders are clarified?

already_counted.description: Clarification, amount determination and completed-record checking remain in the operator steps.

incremental.description: Maintain view filters and check that instruction links remain current.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100, R93: gross7 minus2 upkeep gives net5. Range0-3 assumes only some orders gain from contextual lookup and less repeated entry; no verbal clarification or physical work is cut.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Tend water treatment, refrigeration and heat-exchange equipment

steps.what: Inspect auxiliary equipment and read local operating indications
Tend water treatment, refrigeration units and heat exchangers
Record equipment readings, interventions and observed results

tasks.design: Use a native equipment-specific form in the {OPS_SYSTEM} for readings and tending notes. The operator still inspects, adjusts and verifies the equipment; defaults remove repeated equipment details while the operator captures actual readings and actions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Generic logs require repeating equipment details and arranging the same note fields.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing forms can retain equipment context and show the appropriate reading fields.
tasks.still_hard: Leaks, vibration, contamination and abnormal heat transfer require physical observation and judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The operator distinguishes a misleading indication from an unsafe physical condition.
tasks.altitude: The tending routine stays physical, with a shorter record-entry step.

reach.task: Interpret auxiliary equipment condition during a handover
reach.learn: Equipment symptoms, interventions and operating limits

evidence.claim: Equipment-specific native forms can reduce repeated record entry without automating physical tending; this labour estimate is a model-knowledge scenario.

assumptions: Boundary includes routine tending and its equipment log. A recurring log is assumed; confirm its existence rather than adding documentation solely to claim a gain.

The operator produces equipment id, observation time, reading value, unit, intervention and observed result in s1 through s3. Capturing actual values and checking defaults remains within s3's retained10.5 hours per100 baseline hours.

Existing equipment records supply stable identifiers only. Missing equipment context or an unsuitable form returns to the ordinary manual log; no inferred reading, discrepancy flag or remote control is used.
Test native equipment forms before custom development. No alert, notification, automatic record write or equipment command is hidden in the design.
The proposed reduction concerns repeated fields and note structure, not the same-system save. Upkeep is counted separately.
unknowns: Whether a tending log exists and its actual time share
Whether local conditions permit screen entry
research_questions: Can the current form retain equipment context while leaving actual readings blank?
Does a trial reduce entry time after physical inspection time is held constant?

already_counted.description: Actual reading capture, intervention notes and checking remain in the log step.

incremental.description: Keep equipment form fields and defaults aligned with the tending routine.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100, R95.5: gross4.5 minus1.5 upkeep gives net3. Range0-1.5 assumes a genuine recurring log with repeated fields; an already contextual log or no log yields no gain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Physical pump and auxiliary-equipment decisions remain with the operator; contextual instructions and forms shorten small clerical portions.
reach: Coordinate transfer quantities with tank car, truck, and ship loaders
Share equipment condition with ship engineers
skills_to_grow: Check quantity units and instruction versions
Describe observed conditions without inferring missing measurements
role.ambitious_version: An operator who can verify transfer intent and equipment condition with less repeated navigation and entry.
